title: He promised he would call
pt: Foco da aula: verbos de relato: promised / admitted / denied / suggested

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Amir, welcome back. I am sorry about the delay with your phone repair.
lines.pt: Amir, bem-vindo de volta. Sinto muito pelo atraso no conserto do seu celular.

lines.en: Thanks, Suri. The technician promised he would call me on Monday, but nobody did.
lines.pt: Obrigado, Suri. O técnico prometeu que ligaria na segunda, mas ninguém ligou.

lines.en: He admitted that he had forgotten. He said he had lost your number in the system.
lines.pt: Ele admitiu que tinha esquecido. Disse que tinha perdido seu número no sistema.

lines.en: Really? He denied that he had my number when I called yesterday.
lines.pt: Sério? Ele negou que tivesse meu número quando liguei ontem.

lines.en: I apologize. My manager suggested giving you a loan phone while you wait.
lines.pt: Peço desculpas. Minha gerente sugeriu emprestar um celular a você enquanto espera.

lines.en: That is a good suggestion. Did she also offer to refund part of the repair?
lines.pt: É uma boa sugestão. Ela também se ofereceu para reembolsar parte do conserto?

lines.en: She said she would think about it. She promised to send you an email today.
lines.pt: Disse que ia pensar. Prometeu mandar um e-mail para você hoje.

lines.en: I hope so. Last time they promised to fix the screen in two days, and it took a week.
lines.pt: Espero que sim. Da última vez prometeram consertar a tela em dois dias e levou uma semana.

lines.en: I know. Honestly, the technician admitted that the screen had been more damaged than he expected.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Sinceramente, o técnico admitiu que a tela estava mais danificada do que ele esperava.

lines.en: At least he is honest. I suggested putting a notice on the website for customers.
lines.pt: Pelo menos ele é honesto. Eu sugeri colocar um aviso no site para os clientes.

lines.en: Good idea. I will tell the manager that you suggested it, and I will call you myself.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Vou contar à gerente que você sugeriu isso, e eu mesmo ligo para você.

lines.name: Suri
lines.en: He admitted that he had forgotten. He said he had lost your number in the system.
lines.pt: Ele admitiu que tinha esquecido. Disse que tinha perdido seu número no sistema.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele prometeu que ligaria” e “ele admitiu que tinha esquecido”.
compare.us: Em inglês, cada verbo tem uma estrutura: promised he would call (ou promised to call), admitted that he had forgotten, denied that he had my number, suggested -ing ou suggested that. O verbo recua um passo no tempo.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: He promised he would call.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

facts.label: Verbos de relato
facts.sub: Use promised, admitted, denied e suggested para reportar: He promised he would call. He admitted that he had forgotten.

facts.label: prometeu que… / prometeu…
facts.sub: Use promised he would call ou promised to call. Will vira would na versão reportada. Depois de promised, o sujeito vem logo e o verbo vai para o passado do futuro.

facts.label: admitiu que…
facts.sub: Use admitted that + sujeito + verbo no passado: He admitted that he had forgotten. Também pode usar admitted + -ing: He admitted forgetting. Admitted tem tom formal.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Promised he would call means he said he would call.

items.why: We say he admitted that he had forgotten.

items.s: Denied means said that something is not true.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Promised he would call means he said he would call. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He admitted to forget”. → Falso (We say he admitted that he had forgotten.)
Denied means said that something is not true. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A phone store in Austin · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Tuesday afternoon in Austin. Theo walks into a phone store on Congress Avenue. His phone has been in repair for nine days. Dirk works at the counter and knows the story. Both men remember what people said and promised. Today they practise verbs like promised, admitted and denied.

“Theo, welcome back. I am sorry about the delay with your phone repair.” says Dirk. “Thanks, Dirk. The technician promised he would call me on Monday, but nobody did.” says Theo. “He admitted that he had forgotten. He said he had lost your number in the system.” says Dirk.
